mechanism: Clobazam is metabolized by CYP3A4 and CYP2C19; amoxicillin clavulanate may induce CYP3A4 activity, potentially reducing clobazam levels and seizure control.
action: Monitor seizure control and clobazam efficacy during amoxicillin clavulanate therapy; consider clobazam level monitoring if breakthrough seizures occur.
